needs.what: Station symbols (721) on a static ability (3+ additional land drop) and a keyword (8+ Flying), plus the Spacecraft rule that it is an artifact creature with its printed P/T only at 8+ and a noncreature artifact below it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Ability.threshold is accepted only on activated abilities (loader _compile_threshold refuses others); a trigger `condition` or static `condition` on counters would leave the ability on the permanent, which the packet notes forbid for striations; and nothing gates the Spacecraft becoming a 5/5 artifact creature at 8+ -- a counters-conditioned set_types static would be an invented approximation of rule 721 rather than the station mechanic
